provider: Ministry of Education – Study in India
scholarship_name: Study in India (SII) Scholarship / fee waiver
coverage_amount: USD 3,200–3,500 per year (sources differ) or fee waiver
eligibility: Apply on the SII portal and qualify in the PRAGATII exam
english_requirement: Set by each institute; commonly IELTS 6.0–6.5 or TOEFL; often waived if previous degree was English-medium
notes: An older SII page says the scholarship ended after 2022-23; newer pages describe it as active — check the portal. ICCR 2027-28 call not yet announced (2024-25 ran 4 Apr–15 Jun).

provider: ICCR (Government of India) / High Commission of India, Dhaka
scholarship_name: Suborno Jayanti Scholarship (ICCR, for Bangladeshi nationals)
eligibility: Bangladeshi nationals only; 500 slots, 50% STEM and 50% non-STEM; medical, law and integrated courses excluded; register first on sjsdhaka.gov.in, then apply on the A2A portal; 500-word English essay
english_requirement: English proficiency standard set by the Indian Mission; TOEFL/IELTS scores can be uploaded
notes: Latest guidelines are for 2026-27. Government of India has appointed no agent in Bangladesh — apply only via the portals
